content.question: Beam search with beam size b...
options: always selects the single most probable token at each step and forgets all alternatives
keeps the b most probable partial sequences at each step and returns the overall highest-probability sequence
randomly samples b tokens at each step from the full vocabulary
is only applicable to encoder-only models such as BERT
content.answer: keeps the b most probable partial sequences at each step and returns the overall highest-probability sequence
